authority: Kew POWO/WCVP 2026 direct accepted-name pages and synonym entries
scope: Name, rank, author, genus/family and historical synonym/concept review only; no county-native audit, specimen ID, media or learner changes
recovery_preflight: Historical taxonomy handoffs 085 and 104 already published in GitHub; current claims contain no unexpired active taxonomy-name-fast-pass lease. No safe unpublished unclaimed recovery found among inspected handoffs.

records.synonym_note: Historical Ulmus americana var. rubra is a homotypic synonym of independently accepted Ulmus rubra Muhl.; Ulmus floridana is a synonym of U. americana. Keep U. americana and U. rubra as separate concepts.
records.concept_action: Preserve existing learner identity and source aliases; no specimen or infraspecific reassignment.

records.synonym_note: Ulmus opaca Nutt. and Ulmus monterreyensis C.H.Mull. are heterotypic synonyms; no duplicate concept.
records.concept_action: Preserve existing learner identity and source aliases; no specimen or infraspecific reassignment.

records.synonym_note: Planera parvifolia and Microptelea parvifolia are homotypic synonyms; historical Ulmus parvifolia var. coreana and var. cycloptera are synonyms, not accepted distinct varieties in POWO. Keep distinct from other Ulmus species.
records.concept_action: Preserve existing learner identity and source aliases; no specimen or infraspecific reassignment.

records.synonym_note: Ulmus americana var. rubra is a homotypic synonym of Ulmus rubra, NOT evidence that Ulmus americana and U. rubra are the same species. Ulmus fulva Michx. is a heterotypic synonym.
records.concept_action: Preserve existing learner identity and source aliases; no specimen or infraspecific reassignment.

records.synonym_note: Ungnadia heptaphylla Scheele and U. heterophylla Scheele are heterotypic synonyms; retain existing species concept.
records.concept_action: Preserve existing learner identity and source aliases; no specimen or infraspecific reassignment.

records.synonym_note: Acacia constricta Benth. and Acaciopsis constricta are homotypic synonyms; Acacia constricta var. paucispina is a heterotypic synonym. Preserve Vachellia accepted genus.
records.concept_action: Preserve existing learner identity and source aliases; no specimen or infraspecific reassignment.

records.synonym_note: POWO accepts three varieties: farnesiana, minuta, pinetorum; species-level source cannot assign variety. Acacia farnesiana and Mimosa farnesiana are homotypic synonyms.
records.concept_action: Preserve existing learner identity and source aliases; no specimen or infraspecific reassignment.

records.synonym_note: Viola sororia var. affinis and subsp. affinis are homotypic synonyms; some historical treatments included V. affinis in V. sororia, but POWO accepts V. affinis independently. No specimen ID reassignment.
records.concept_action: Preserve existing learner identity and source aliases; no specimen or infraspecific reassignment.
